home.title: What do you want to plan?
home.subtitle: Pick a planner. Everything is stored in one project file you can save and load.
home.restoreBanner: An autosaved session from {{date}} was found.

next.title: Next: {{doc}}
next.body: “{{doc}}” is still empty. Planning it next follows the recommended order.

visionFirst.title: Write the vision first
visionFirst.body: Design documents are being filled in, but the Vision is empty. It anchors every later decision.

emptySection.title: “{{section}}” is empty
emptySection.body: Add the first entry to start this section.

kanban.title: Too many items in one column
kanban.body: “{{column}}” has {{count}} items (limit {{limit}}). Consider finishing or splitting some.

timeline.title: Overlapping timeline items
timeline.body: {{count}} items overlap in the same lane: {{pairs}}.

outlier.title: Unusual “{{field}}” values
outlier.body: {{count}} values are far outside the typical range: {{names}}. Check balance.

formulaFail.title: Formula “{{name}}” cannot be evaluated
formulaFail.body: The result is not a finite number (e.g. division by zero).

milestonePast.title: Milestone “{{name}}” is overdue
milestonePast.body: Its due date ({{due}}) has passed and it is not marked Done.

backlog.title: Backlog items lack estimate or milestone

oqDecidedNoText.title: A decided question has no decision text
oqDecidedNoText.body: {{count}} question(s) are marked Decided but the Decision field is empty: {{names}}. Write down what was chosen and why.

oqNotWrittenBack.title: Decision not written back to a doc
oqNotWrittenBack.body: {{count}} decided question(s) list no doc under “Updated in docs”: {{names}}. Carry the decision into the affected design doc and note it here.

oqOverdue.title: Question past its due date
oqOverdue.body: {{count}} open question(s) are past their due date: {{names}}. Decide, or move the date if it is still being discussed.

visionPitch.title: The pitch is still empty
visionPitch.body: Write a draft one-sentence pitch; you can refine it once the rest of the vision is clear.

visionNoPillars.title: Add your design pillars
visionNoPillars.body: No pillars yet. 3–5 pillars give you a test for accepting or rejecting features.

visionPillarCount.title: {{count}} design pillars
visionPillarCount.body: The suggested range is {{min}}–{{max}} pillars. Too few is vague, too many stops guiding decisions.

visionPillarTest.title: Pillars without a decision test
visionPillarTest.body: {{count}} pillar(s) have no “how it guides a decision”: {{names}}.

visionUspBenefit.title: USPs without a player benefit
visionUspBenefit.body: {{count}} USP(s) do not say what the player gains: {{names}}.

visionScopeBucket.title: Scope items without a decision
visionScopeBucket.body: {{count}} scope item(s) have no bucket (MVP / Later / Out of scope): {{names}}.

visionScopeMvp.title: Nothing is in the MVP yet
visionScopeMvp.body: Scope items exist, but none are marked “In MVP”.

visionPitchShape.title: The pitch may not read as one sentence
visionPitchShape.body: The pitch has {{words}} words and may be: {{problems}}. Aim for one sentence of about 10–30 words: who plays, what they do, and why.

visionScopeNoPillar.title: MVP items that serve no pillar
visionScopeNoPillar.body: {{count}} MVP scope item(s) are not tied to any design pillar: {{names}}. If none fits, the item may not belong in the MVP.

visionUspPillar.title: USPs not backed by a pillar

visionPillarUnused.title: Pillars nothing points at
visionPillarUnused.body: {{count}} pillar(s) have no scope item or USP linked: {{names}}. Link the features that carry them, or reconsider the pillar.

visionPillarNotInMvp.title: Pillars missing from the MVP
visionPillarNotInMvp.body: {{count}} pillar(s) have no “In MVP” scope item: {{names}}. The first release would not show them.

roadmapConflict.title: Dependencies start too early in {{section}}
roadmapConflict.body: {{count}} item(s) start before a predecessor ends: {{names}}. Move them or adjust the dependency.

roadmapCycle.title: Circular dependencies in {{section}}
roadmapCycle.body: These items depend on each other in a loop: {{names}}.

roadmapMissing.title: Schedule gaps in {{section}}
roadmapMissing.body: {{count}} item(s) have no start or duration, so they are left out of the totals.

roadmapExit.title: Phases without exit criteria
roadmapExit.body: {{count}} phase(s) have no measurable exit criteria: {{names}}.

roadmapOverload.title: Phases over capacity
roadmapOverload.body: Task effort exceeds the capacity of: {{names}}.

roadmapConfidence.title: Low-confidence estimates
roadmapConfidence.body: {{count}} unfinished task(s) have a low-confidence estimate: {{names}}.

roadmapDecision.title: Gate decisions are due
roadmapDecision.body: {{count}} gate(s) belong to phases that should have ended but have no decision: {{names}}.

roadmapLate.title: Phases past their end with open tasks
roadmapLate.body: {{count}} phase(s) should have ended but still have open tasks: {{names}} ({{open}} open in the first). Close the tasks, move them, or replan the phase.

roadmapCutsShort.title: The cut plan does not cover the overload
roadmapCutsShort.body: Tasks exceed phase capacity by {{over}} person-weeks, but all cuts together save {{saved}}. Add cuts, link them to tasks, or give them a saving estimate.

roadmapCutProtected.title: Cuts touching protected pillars
roadmapCutProtected.body: {{count}} cut(s) drop Vision scope items that serve a protected pillar ({{pillars}}): {{names}}.

coreLoopScales.title: Time scales not covered yet
coreLoopScales.body: Consider describing a loop for: {{names}}. Not every game needs all four.

coreLoopReward.title: Loops without a reward
coreLoopReward.body: {{count}} loop(s) have no reward: {{names}}. What does the player get for completing them?

coreLoopDecision.title: Loops without a next decision
coreLoopDecision.body: {{count}} loop(s) don’t say what the player decides next: {{names}}. A meaningful choice is what makes a loop repeat.

coreLoopProgression.title: Loops that don’t build toward a longer loop
coreLoopProgression.body: {{count}} loop(s) don’t link to a longer loop: {{names}}.

coreLoopUnlinked.title: Loops not linked to the diagram
coreLoopUnlinked.body: {{count}} loop(s) have no nodes in the loop diagram: {{names}}.

coreLoopIsolated.title: Isolated nodes in the loop diagram

coreLoopFeedback.title: The loop diagram has no feedback path
coreLoopFeedback.body: No connection leads back to an earlier node, so the diagram reads as a line, not a loop. Add an edge from a reward or outcome back to an action.

coreLoopDirection.title: “Builds toward” points to a shorter loop
coreLoopDirection.body: {{count}} link(s) go to a loop on the same or a shorter time scale: {{names}}. “Builds toward” should only point to longer loops.

coreLoopPacing.title: A loop builds toward one that is not longer
coreLoopPacing.body: By the cycle lengths, {{count}} link(s) point to a loop that takes no longer than the loop itself: {{names}}. Check the lengths or the link.

coreLoopPillars.title: Pillars with no loop behind them
coreLoopPillars.body: {{count}} Vision pillar(s) are not served by any loop: {{names}}. A pillar the player never repeats is easy to lose.

coreLoopRewardRefs.title: Rewards not linked to game content
coreLoopRewardRefs.body: {{count}} loop(s) describe a reward but do not name the resource, item or building it is: {{names}}.

difficultyRange.title: Values outside the intended range
difficultyRange.body: {{count}} value(s) fall outside the parameter’s range: {{names}}. Adjust the value or the range.

difficultyReversal.title: Parameters that move against their direction
difficultyReversal.body: Between adjacent presets these change the opposite way to their direction: {{names}}. Mark a parameter as an intentional exception if that is deliberate.

difficultyContext.title: Parameters without tuning context
difficultyContext.body: {{count}} parameter(s) lack a direction or range: {{names}}. These make reversals and out-of-range values detectable.

difficultyIntent.title: Presets without an intent
difficultyIntent.body: {{count}} preset(s) don’t say what they should feel like: {{names}}.

difficultySpacing.title: Levels that are too close or out of order
difficultySpacing.body: By overall pressure, these neighbouring levels barely differ or the harder one is easier: {{names}}. See the Pressure view on Presets.

difficultyBaseline.title: Baselines outside their range
difficultyBaseline.body: {{count}} parameter(s) have a baseline outside Range min–max: {{names}}.

difficultyUnused.title: Parameters no system reads
difficultyUnused.body: {{count}} parameter(s) are not linked from Player, Combat or Trade, so they only change numbers in this document: {{names}}.

difficultyNoPresets.title: No difficulty presets described
difficultyNoPresets.body: Describe what each preset should feel like and who it is for.

diplomacyProfile.title: Faction profiles are incomplete
diplomacyProfile.body: {{count}} faction(s) lack goals, a capital or key characters: {{names}}.

diplomacyNoThresholds.title: No relationship levels yet
diplomacyNoThresholds.body: Define what changes at each reputation level: trade, attacks, quests, biome access.

diplomacyRanges.title: Relationship levels have gaps or overlaps
diplomacyRanges.body: {{names}}. Adjust the minimums or maximums so every value maps to one level.

diplomacyAsymmetry.title: Asymmetric relations to review
diplomacyAsymmetry.body: {{count}} pair(s) differ between directions: {{names}}. Fine if intended; otherwise mirror them.

diplomacyGraph.title: Graph and matrix disagree
diplomacyGraph.body: {{count}} graph relation(s) contradict the matrix: {{names}}. The matrix is the reputation model; update whichever is out of date.

diplomacyMatrix.title: Relationship matrix has empty cells
diplomacyMatrix.body: {{count}} relation(s) between factions are not set yet.

townNoSource.title: Resources with no source
townNoSource.body: Buildings consume {{names}}, but nothing produces it and no base starts with any.

townNoConsumer.title: Resources nothing uses
townNoConsumer.body: {{names}} are produced but never consumed by a building. Fine if they are sold or exported.

townDepleting.title: Resources running out
townDepleting.body: At the planned rates, {{names}} run out before the estimate horizon ends.

townWorkforce.title: Not enough workers
townWorkforce.body: Buildings need {{count}} more workers than the population available.

diplomacySpillover.title: Actions without spillover
diplomacySpillover.body: {{count}} action(s) involve a faction with hostile rivals but record no spillover: {{names}}.

diplomacyMarks.title: Scale markers to check
diplomacyMarks.body: The overview markers do not fit the scale: {{names}}. The Scale view under Relationship levels shows them on the bar.

diplomacyUnlinked.title: Factions no other module uses
diplomacyUnlinked.body: {{count}} faction(s) are not referenced by quests, characters, merchants, biomes or other modules yet: {{names}}. The Footprint view shows where each faction appears.

diplomacyUntouched.title: Reputation no action changes
diplomacyUntouched.body: No action changes the player’s reputation with {{count}} faction(s), directly or by spillover: {{names}}. Try them in the Simulator view.

worldReach.title: Biomes nothing unlocks
worldReach.body: {{count}} biome(s) have no gate met in another biome and no incoming arrow in the progression graph: {{names}}. Link a boss or quest under Entry, or mark them optional if that is intended.

worldZones.title: Biomes missing on the map
worldZones.body: {{count}} biome(s) have no zone on the map sketch: {{names}}.

worldZoneLinks.title: Map zones not linked to a biome
worldZoneLinks.body: {{count}} zone(s) are unlinked or point to a deleted biome: {{names}}.

worldGraph.title: Entry condition and graph disagree
worldGraph.body: The entry type differs from the connections in the progression graph for: {{names}}. The biome's entry condition is authoritative.

worldEnemies.title: Biomes without enemies
worldEnemies.body: {{count}} biome(s) list no enemies or bosses: {{names}}.

worldLocked.title: Biomes that can never open
worldLocked.body: {{count}} biome(s) need a quest or boss that is only met inside a biome the player can’t reach yet (or inside the biome itself): {{names}}. See the Unlock path view.

worldLevels.title: Level ranges run backwards
worldLevels.body: {{count}} biome(s) start at a lower player level than a biome of an earlier role: {{names}}. Check the Threat view.

npcStatCoverage.title: Stats without a rule
npcStatCoverage.body: {{count}} stat(s) have no entry under Stats yet: {{names}}. Describe what each one does.

npcNeedCoverage.title: Needs without a rule
npcNeedCoverage.body: {{count}} need(s) have no entry under Needs: {{names}}. Say what satisfies them and what happens when they are unmet.

npcNeedConsequence.title: Needs with no consequence
npcNeedConsequence.body: {{count}} need rule(s) do not say what happens when the need goes unmet: {{names}}.

npcNeedSupply.title: Needs with no supply
npcNeedSupply.body: {{count}} need rule(s) name no resource or building that satisfies them: {{names}}. The needs balance cannot check them.

npcStatRange.title: Stats outside the scale
npcStatRange.body: {{count}} archetype(s) have stats outside {{min}}–{{max}}: {{names}}. Fix the values or widen the scale in Overview.

npcFormula.title: Formulas that do not evaluate
npcFormula.body: {{count}} formula(s) fail with the stat variables: {{names}}.

npcStages.title: Life stages have gaps or overlaps

npcRelationLevels.title: Relationship levels have gaps or overlaps

npcProfessionJob.title: Professions without a job description
npcProfessionJob.body: {{count}} profession(s) used by archetypes have no entry under Work and professions: {{names}}.

npcJobBuilding.title: Job and building disagree
npcJobBuilding.body: These jobs are placed in buildings whose worker professions in Town do not include them: {{names}}.

npcShares.title: Population shares do not add up
npcShares.body: Archetype shares add up to {{total}}%, not 100%.

npcEvents.title: Events are incomplete
npcEvents.body: {{count}} event(s) lack a chance or any effect: {{names}}.

npcBalance.title: Town cannot meet the population's needs
npcBalance.body: {{count}} scenario(s) fall short: {{names}}. Compare them in the Needs balance view.

playerSurvivalRestore.title: Survival stats nothing restores
playerSurvivalRestore.body: {{count}} survival stat(s) name no way to restore them: {{names}}.

playerSurvivalPace.title: Unusual survival pacing
playerSurvivalPace.body: On {{level}}, these reach critical outside {{min}}–{{max}} real minutes: {{names}}. Check the Depletion view.

playerSurvivalDifficulty.title: Survival not linked to difficulty
playerSurvivalDifficulty.body: {{count}} survival stat(s) ignore the Difficulty parameters: {{names}}. Link one to scale decay per level.

playerCurveMissing.title: No levelling curve yet
playerCurveMissing.body: Set a level cap and an XP formula in Levelling, so XP sources and skill budgets can be checked.

playerXpSourcesNone.title: No XP sources
playerXpSourcesNone.body: Add where XP comes from (kills, quests, crafting…) to estimate how long each level takes.

playerXpSourcesRate.title: XP sources have no rate
playerXpSourcesRate.body: Give at least one XP source an XP value and actions per hour to see hours per level.

playerCastEntry.title: Casts without an entry
playerCastEntry.body: {{count}} cast(s) from the catalog have no entry under Casts: {{names}}.

playerTreeOver.title: Skill trees cost more than the budget
playerTreeOver.body: Total cost vs. points at the level cap: {{names}}. Fine if players should specialise; otherwise lower costs or raise points.

playerTreeUnder.title: Skill trees use under half the budget
playerTreeUnder.body: Total cost vs. points at the level cap: {{names}}. Players may run out of things to learn.

playerSkillAbility.title: Active skills without an ability
playerSkillAbility.body: {{count}} active skill(s) or spell(s) grant no ability: {{names}}.

playerAbilityCost.title: Abilities without cost or cooldown
playerAbilityCost.body: {{count}} ability(ies) lack a resource cost or a cooldown: {{names}}.

playerAbilityCast.title: Skill grants another cast's ability
playerAbilityCast.body: These skills grant an ability of a different cast: {{names}}.

playerStartGear.title: Casts start empty-handed
playerStartGear.body: {{count}} cast(s) have no starting abilities or gear: {{names}}.

itemsNoSource.title: Items nobody can obtain
itemsNoSource.body: {{count}} item(s) have no recipe, loot table, merchant, reward, starting gear or Town output: {{names}}.

itemsUnused.title: Items nothing uses
itemsUnused.body: {{count}} item(s) are never an ingredient, never restore anything and are not traded: {{names}}.

itemsValueLoss.title: Crafting changes value oddly
itemsValueLoss.body: These recipes make less than their ingredients are worth, or more than {{max}}× their worth: {{names}}. Check the Crafting tree.

itemsCoverage.title: Gaps in rarity coverage
itemsCoverage.body: {{count}} type and rarity pair(s) have no item between rarities the type already uses: {{names}}.

itemsTiers.title: Rarity or quality tiers out of order
itemsTiers.body: {{names}}. Rarer should drop less and be worth more.

itemsLoot.title: Loot tables need attention
itemsLoot.body: {{count}} table(s) lack a source or weights, roll zero times, or guarantee a deleted item: {{names}}.

itemsTypeFields.title: Fields that do not fit the item type
itemsTypeFields.body: These items have values in field groups their type does not use: {{names}}.

itemsBasics.title: Items missing basics
itemsBasics.body: {{count}} item(s) lack a stack size (resources) or weight and durability (gear and tools): {{names}}.

combatEnemyBasics.title: Enemies missing basics
combatEnemyBasics.body: {{count}} enemy(ies) lack a biome, HP, damage or attacks per second: {{names}}.

combatTtk.title: Unusual fight lengths
combatTtk.body: With “{{loadout}}” on {{level}}: {{names}}. Check the Combat sandbox.

combatThreatRamp.title: Threat drops in later biomes
combatThreatRamp.body: These enemies are weaker than the median of an earlier biome stage: {{names}}. Check the Threat curve.

combatImmune.title: Enemies the player cannot hurt
combatImmune.body: These resist every damage type the player can deal: {{names}}.

combatNoLoot.title: Enemies that drop nothing
combatNoLoot.body: {{count}} enemy(ies) or boss(es) are not a source in any Items loot table: {{names}}.

combatBossGates.title: Bosses that gate nothing
combatBossGates.body: These bosses unlock nothing and no biome or progression step requires them: {{names}}.

combatVariants.title: Incomplete variants
combatVariants.body: {{count}} variant(s) lack a base enemy, a time or event, or a multiplier: {{names}}.

combatStatus.title: Incomplete status effects
combatStatus.body: {{count}} status effect(s) lack a duration, or tick damage without an interval: {{names}}.

combatFormula.title: Damage formula does not work
combatFormula.body: The damage formula fails with attack, armor, resist and crit: {{error}}.

timeDayCoverage.title: Day phases do not cover the day

timeDayLength.title: No day length
timeDayLength.body: Set how many real minutes an in-game day lasts, so phases convert to real time.

timePhaseBasics.title: Incomplete day phases
timePhaseBasics.body: {{count}} phase(s) lack a start, a duration or a time-of-day link (used by NPC routines and music): {{names}}.

timeNightHarder.title: Night is not more dangerous
timeNightHarder.body: {{names}}. The game design says nights are darker and monsters stronger.

timeWeatherOver.title: Weather adds up past 100 %
timeWeatherOver.body: In these biomes the weather frequencies add up to more than 100 %: {{names}}.

timeWeatherNone.title: Biomes without weather
timeWeatherNone.body: {{count}} biome(s) have no weather at all: {{names}}.

timeEvents.title: Incomplete events
timeEvents.body: {{count}} event(s) lack a usable schedule, a duration or any effect: {{names}}.

timeCoincide.title: Events can coincide without a rule
timeCoincide.body: These events can happen at the same time but have no priority and do not both stack: {{names}}. See the Year strip.

timeSeasons.title: Seasons do not fill the year
timeSeasons.body: Seasons add up to {{total}} days, the year has {{year}}.

timeExtremes.title: Extreme multipliers
timeExtremes.body: These multipliers are ×0 or above ×5, which may be a typo: {{names}}.

tradeArbitrage.title: Money loops
tradeArbitrage.body: {{count}} way(s) to make money from nothing: {{names}}. See the Price ladder.

tradeMarginConflict.title: Two sets of margins
tradeMarginConflict.body: Trade and Town both set the player’s buy/sell price and they differ ({{names}}). Trade’s values are used; clear Town’s or make them match.

tradeRuleScope.title: Price rules without a scope
tradeRuleScope.body: {{count}} rule(s) have a factor but nothing they apply to, so they are not used: {{names}}.

tradeFormulaVars.title: Unknown formula variables
tradeFormulaVars.body: The price formula uses variables the price chain does not provide: {{names}}. Use value, base, mult, margin, markup, rep, difficulty or rule, or set the variable on the formula.

tradeWanderingRule.title: Wandering merchants never come
tradeWanderingRule.body: {{count}} wandering merchant(s) have no roll interval or chance, here or in the Wandering merchant rules: {{names}}.

tradeCapitalGate.title: Capital merchants without a gate
tradeCapitalGate.body: {{count}} faction capital merchant(s) lack a faction or a required relationship level: {{names}}.

tradeRarityCap.title: Goods above the rarity limit
tradeRarityCap.body: These merchants sell items rarer than their highest rarity: {{names}}.

tradeExclusive.title: Exclusive goods sold elsewhere
tradeExclusive.body: These exclusive goods are also sold by another merchant: {{names}}.

tradeUnsold.title: Valuable items nobody trades
tradeUnsold.body: {{count}} item(s) with a value have no merchant that sells or buys them: {{names}}.

tradeNoSinks.title: Money only comes in
tradeNoSinks.body: There are money sources but no sinks, so money piles up. Add repairs, upkeep, fees or purchases.

tradePiling.title: Money piles up
tradePiling.body: In the last period the player keeps {{kept}} % of their income (tolerance {{tolerance}} %). Late-game sinks keep prices meaningful.

tradeRepCoverage.title: Relationship levels without a price factor
tradeRepCoverage.body: {{count}} relationship level(s) have no buy price factor and count as ×1: {{names}}.

storyQuestCycle.title: Quests require each other in a loop
storyQuestCycle.body: These quests wait for each other, so none of them can start: {{names}}. See Quest flow.

storyActOrder.title: Needs something from a later act
storyActOrder.body: {{count}} requirement(s) point forward in the story: {{names}}.

storyEndings.title: Unreachable endings
storyEndings.body: No path reaches these endings: {{names}}. See Ending paths.

storyEndingsEmpty.title: Endings without requirements
storyEndingsEmpty.body: {{count}} ending(s) need no quest, option or reputation yet: {{names}}.

storyQuestBasics.title: Incomplete main and faction quests
storyQuestBasics.body: {{count}} quest(s) lack a giver, objectives, an act or any reward: {{names}}.

storyReputation.title: Reputation out of reach
storyReputation.body: Quest rewards and choices never reach the level something asks for: {{names}}.

storyGraphSync.title: Sketch and quest data disagree
storyGraphSync.body: The dialog sketch connects these quests, but no requirement or option does: {{names}}.

uiUnreachable.title: Screens nobody can open
uiUnreachable.body: {{count}} screen(s) cannot be reached from {{entry}} through the flow graph or any button: {{names}}. See Screen map.

uiDeadEnd.title: Screens without a way back
uiDeadEnd.body: {{count}} screen(s) have no back, close or navigation out: {{names}}.

uiNavMismatch.title: Flow graph and buttons disagree
uiNavMismatch.body: {{count}} connection(s) exist only on one side: {{names}}. “Add arrows from wireframes” in Screen flow fixes the button-only ones.

uiLayout.title: Layout problems
uiLayout.body: Small text or targets, elements outside the safe area or the screen, overlapping controls or broken links: {{names}}. Turn on Checks in the Wireframe view.

uiTextFit.title: Labels too long for translation
uiTextFit.body: {{count}} label(s) would not fit at the configured text expansion, e.g. {{names}}.

uiUnbound.title: HUD widgets without data
uiUnbound.body: {{count}} widget(s) show nothing yet: {{names}}. Pick what they show under Data in the properties.

uiControlConflicts.title: Two actions on one input
uiControlConflicts.body: These actions share a binding in the same context: {{names}}. See Binding map.

uiScreenBasics.title: Screens not ready
uiScreenBasics.body: {{count}} screen(s) lack a purpose, a wireframe or states: {{names}}. See Readiness.

ai.noKey: AI is optional. Enter an API key in the settings to enable it (the key is kept in memory only).
ai.estimate: Estimated input: ~{{input}} tokens, max output: {{output}} tokens
ai.noPrice: set prices in settings for a cost estimate
ai.budgetExceeded: This request would exceed your configured limit.
ai.showPayload: Show exact text to be sent
ai.applied: Applied {{n}} change(s), skipped {{skipped}}. Ctrl+Z undoes all at once.
ai.stale: Some entries changed since the proposal; they were skipped.
ai.invalidAnswer: The AI answer could not be used:
ai.noDocsHits: No matching documentation found for this question.
ai.needCollection: Open a list-type section (e.g. Items) in the editor first.
ai.needFormulaSection: Open a formulas section in the editor first.

placeholder.generate: Direction, e.g. 'desert bandits with unusual weapons'
placeholder.formula: What should be checked or improved?

ai.securityNote: AI is optional. Your API key is kept in browser memory only: it is lost on reload and is never saved to the project, autosave, exports or storage. Requests go directly from your browser to the selected provider. Use a key with a spending limit. The AI can only suggest changes; nothing is applied without your approval.
ai.limitsHelp: Limits and usage are stored locally in this browser (never the key).
ai.usage: Used today: {{dt}} tokens (${{dc}}); this month: {{mt}} tokens (${{mc}})
ai.docsFolderHelp: Optional: pick a docs/ folder with Markdown files for the documentation Q&A. Files are read locally and kept in memory.
